extension.description: High-performance CSV, TSV, JSONL & Log editor and viewer with JSONC sidecar metadata (.metatext.jsonc)
command.openWithEditor: MetaText Editor: Open with MetaText Editor
config.language.description: UI display language for MetaText Editor ('auto' follows the VS Code display language).
config.defaultFontSize.description: Default cell font size in pixels when not specified in .metatext.jsonc.
config.defaultRowHeight.description: Default row height in pixels when not specified in .metatext.jsonc.
config.defaultMarkerColor.description: Default highlight color when adding a new row marker.
config.showRowNumbers.description: Show 1-based row numbers in the left gutter.
config.noHeaderColumnStyle.description: Column header naming style when the first row is not a header ('excel' for A, B, C... or 'numbered' for column 1, 2, 3...).
config.sidecarVisibility.description: How .metatext.jsonc sidecar files are displayed in the Explorer.
config.sidecarVisibility.nest: Nest .metatext.jsonc under its parent file in the Explorer (default).
config.sidecarVisibility.hide: Hide .metatext.jsonc completely from the Explorer via files.exclude.
config.sidecarVisibility.show: Show .metatext.jsonc as normal sibling files in the Explorer.
